## Orbit Time v1.3

### What's New
- 🌍 Global holidays — holidays added by the organization's holiday manager are shared across all employees.
- 📊 Improved attendance reports with overtime information.
- 🔔 Smarter notifications with corrected leave, holiday, week-off, attendance and missed-attendance logic.
- 🛠️ Improved attendance statistics and status handling — holidays and leave are never counted as absences, and worked hours show minutes.
- ⏰ The shift reminder no longer fires on leave days, holidays or week-offs.
- ⬆️ Tapping "Later" on an update now keeps that update quiet until a newer one comes out.
